name: France
intro: Unlock the home of haute couture, fine vintage vineyards, and legendary art. From the historic avenues of Paris to the lavender hills of Provence, France is the ultimate cultural voyage.
bestSeason: April to June (Springtime) & September to October (Grape harvest)
weather: Temperate maritime climate. Pleasant warm summers (20°C to 28°C), cool winters (3°C to 8°C) with regular rainfall.
visaInfo: Schengen Visa required for Indian passport holders.
flightDuration: Approx 8-9 hours direct flight from New Delhi or Mumbai.
highlights: Marvel at the Eiffel Tower from a private Seine cruise
Enjoy after-hours private access to the masterpieces in the Louvre Museum
Tour historic wine cellars and vineyards in Reims and Bordeaux
Stay in converted 17th-century royal chateaux in the Loire Valley

famousPlaces.name: Parisian Art
famousPlaces.shortDesc: The city of light, famous for iconic landmarks, fashion houses, and world-class museum collections.
famousPlaces.overview: Paris is a global center for art, fashion, and gastronomy. Built along the Seine River, its broad 19th-century boulevards are lined with cafes, boutiques, and classic Haussmannian facades.
famousPlaces.bestTimeToVisit: April to June, September to October

hotels.name: Ritz Paris
hotels.description: Historic grand hotel located on Place Vendôme, famous for absolute luxury.

famousPlaces.meals: Fresh butter croissants and Michelin-starred French dinners.
famousPlaces.transport: Private chauffeur sedan transfers and Paris Metro cards.
famousPlaces.activities: Eiffel Tower VIP Platform Tour, Seine River Private Cruise, Louvre Museum Tour.

faqs.q: How do we skip the lines at the Louvre?
faqs.a: Our packages include reserved skip-the-line group or private guide entry tickets for all major museums.

reviews.author: Elena G.
reviews.text: The Seine cruise at twilight as the Eiffel Tower started sparkling was pure magic.

itinerary.title: Welcome to Paris & Seine Sunset Cruise
itinerary.morning: Airport pickup and transfer to Ritz Paris. Rest.
itinerary.afternoon: Stroll the Tuileries gardens and shop at Place Vendôme.
itinerary.evening: Private Seine cruise with champagne, watching the monuments light up.

itinerary.title: Louvre Masterpieces & Eiffel Tower
itinerary.morning: Skip-the-line guided tour of the Louvre seeing the Mona Lisa and Venus de Milo.
itinerary.afternoon: Stroll the Champs-Élysées up to the Arc de Triomphe.
itinerary.evening: VIP dinner at the Eiffel Tower restaurant with panoramic city views.
